moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-caret-typewriter, written here): Mono text (demo 34 px, weight 600). Chars appear one per 70 ms (steps(N): width 0 → N ch over N × 70 ms; demo capped 1.5 s total) from 0.4 s. Caret: accent bar 0.12 em wide (demo 3 px), 1 em tall, 3 px after the last char; solid while typing, then blinks with a 0.75 s period, step-end (0.375 s on / off). Full-width CJK counts as 2 ch. Demo clears at 3.45 s; loop 3.75 s. Params: rate: mỗi ký tự (0.07 s) · caret: bề rộng (0.12 em) · blink: chu kỳ nhấp nháy (0.75 s).
